title.narrative: Process Optimization and Installation of a Model Tannery Wastewater Treatment Plant

description.narrative: This project is specifically meant to introduce process optimization options through the application of cleaner technologies as well as establish a wastewater treatment in a selected tannery, to serve as a state of art waste water treatment plant (primary) (WWT). The project will also introduce the UNIDO- developed TEST - Transfer of Environmentally Sound Technologies # Methodology as example of cleaner technologies methods. Working conditions for factory workers are also expected to be improved through the introduction of Operational Safety Health (OSH) operations. Furthermore, this project will serve as an example of cooperation between the Government and the private sector. This Project is fully in line with UNDAF Outcome 3: Livelihoods and Productive Sectors # Sub-Outcome 3.5 A more equitable and competitive and socially responsible private sector is in place # Output 3.5.5. Economic and Environmental performance of local-industries improved through the implementation of environmental-friendly technologies in selected SMEs clusters (UNIDO, UNEP).
